confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Seattle price levels, not live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak tourist season and rates swing widely, and they include estimated US lodging taxes and fees. The FX observation comes from an RBA table seen in search results, and the 2026-10-16 value may be provisional until the 4 pm fix.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of major US West Coast metro pricing (Portland, San Francisco-adjacent mid-tier, and Vancouver BC for comparison), adjusted to Seattle's mid-to-high US restaurant and bar prices and summer hotel demand.
